name: Tempester 1.6.4.0 — room, reports and fixes
summary: Everything in 1.6.3.0, plus room for new functions, the machine reporting its mixer, tempo, mode and exact version to an editor, and five bug fixes.

fixes: In Pad to Note Mode « Mutes », a MIDI note mutes the sound of its own pad, in bank A or B, and a note that is no pad's note no longer toggles a stray sound.
The first Save Beat or Save Project after power-on offers « Beats 1 » or « Projects 1 », not the Factory folder.
Undo All Snds and Undo Beat restore the sound types, play states, Voice Assign reservations and pad LEDs, as Undo Sound does.
Reverse Off clears the reverse of every beat and the live reverse.
The Save/Load browser lists a folder much faster (one pass over the directory instead of one per file).
additions: Turning Level, Pan, Delay Send, Delay Time, Delay Repeats, BPM, Swing, Volume, Distort or Compress on the machine is reported to an editor (NRPN 230-239 on Remote Pad OUT), so the Tempester app follows the machine.
The Pad Function mode (16 Beats ... 16 Levels) is reported as CC 106 on Remote Pad OUT.
The machine answers its exact Tempester version on request (SysEx F0 01 28 43 F7).
changes: 9.9 KB of the official code that can never run is erased, to make room for new functions; the machine runs exactly the same instructions.

description: 1.6.3.0 plus n°37-n°41 and n°43-n°46, each proved on the test builds 1.6.4.0-a (n°37), -b (n°38), -c (n°39, n°40) and -d (n°41, n°43-n°46), and together on this image. n°42 (slave Start) and n°47 (Copy Beat onto the playing beat) are not made: see Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
